products.title: Dell XPS 13 9350 Laptop
products.description: The Dell XPS 13 9350 is a premium, ultra-portable business laptop featuring a 13.4-inch InfinityEdge FHD+ anti-glare display with a 30-120Hz refresh rate. Powered by the Intel Core Ultra 7-256V processor with a dedicated Intel AI Boost NPU, it is designed for high-efficiency multitasking and generative AI workloads. The device is crafted from machined CNC aluminum, weighing only 2.6 lbs, and includes 16GB of DDR5 RAM, a 1TB NVMe SSD, and Intel Arc Graphics. It offers cutting-edge connectivity with Killer Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 5.4, and two Thunderbolt 4 ports.

products.title: Xps 13 Laptop
products.description: The Dell XPS 13 (model XPS9350) is a high-performance, ultra-portable Copilot+ PC designed for professionals and creators. This upgraded configuration features an Intel Core Ultra 7 256V processor with an integrated NPU (47 TOPS) and Intel Arc Graphics, paired with 16GB of fast 8533 MT/s DDR5 RAM and a 1TB SSD for rapid storage. It boasts a 13.4-inch WUXGA (1920x1200) InfinityEdge display with a 120Hz variable refresh rate and 400-nit brightness. Weighing only 2.70 lbs, it offers exceptional portability and up to 26 hours of battery life. Key AI-powered features include Recall, Cocreate, and Windows Studio Effects. Connectivity is handled via two Thunderbolt 4 ports, Wi-Fi 7, and Bluetooth 5.4.
